info.name: FieldOps API - Live Environment - Complete Requirements
info.description:
# FieldOps API

This collection is based on the current worktree controller, DTO, ProblemDetails and integration-test contracts.

Run folders 00-05 in order against a disposable/demo database. Setup discovers Employee/Store IDs and Store coordinates from demo Visit data because the project intentionally has no Employee/Store catalog endpoints. Scenario dates are regenerated on every setup run.

This live collection defaults to `https://fieldops.161-35-23-78.sslip.io`. It creates and mutates demo Visit records, so run it only against the intended evaluation environment.

Coverage: `/health`, Development-only `/openapi/v1.json`, every Visit endpoint, every list filter, pagination, sorting, empty state, validation, create/duplicate rules, start/distance rules, completion/idempotency, cancel/concurrency and missing-resource errors.

Requirement 11's Analytics URL is included in folder 06 as a manual external contract. It is not a FieldOps public endpoint and the supplied domain is a placeholder.

Requirement 12 asks for a design rather than new offline endpoints. The collection therefore does not invent sync routes; it demonstrates implemented duplicate/conflict behavior and Complete retry idempotency.
